capabilities: Move completed tasks from a todo note to an archive note via ribbon or command
Schedule automatic daily archiving at a set time, with catch-up after Obsidian was closed
Append completion dates in YYYY-MM-DD format to archived tasks
Archive indented sub-items together with their completed parent task
extras: README warns to enable automatic archiving on only one device when using Obsidian Sync across devices, to avoid conflicting edits; only tasks in the form - [x] are archived.
motivation: The README frames it as cleaning up your todo list at the end of the day so the next morning shows only open tasks.
problem: Completed tasks clutter a todo note, and Obsidian has no built-in way to move them to a separate done note.
summary: Task-archiving plugin that moves completed tasks from a todo note to an archive note on click or on a daily schedule.
